Husk closed while the game was running
It stopped with \(name). The report has the full log of that run.
SIGABRT, the game or a library gave up
SIGILL, an instruction this device does not run
SIGSYS, a system call iOS does not allow
The runtime could not start it. The report says which part was missing.
Nothing was recorded, which usually means iOS ended Husk for using too much memory, or Husk was closed from the app switcher.
